[package]
name = "async-openai"
version = "0.27.2"
authors = ["Himanshu Neema"]
categories = ["api-bindings", "web-programming", "asynchronous"]
keywords = ["openai", "async", "openapi", "ai"]
description = "Rust library for OpenAI"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.75"
license = "MIT"
readme = "README.md"
homepage = "https://github.com/64bit/async-openai"
repository = "https://github.com/64bit/async-openai"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[features]
default = ["rustls"]
rustls = ["reqwest/rustls-tls-native-roots"]
rustls-webpki-roots = ["reqwest/rustls-tls-webpki-roots"]
native-tls = ["reqwest/native-tls"]
native-tls-vendored = ["reqwest/native-tls-vendored"]
realtime = ["dep:tokio-tungstenite"]

[dependencies]
base64 = "0.22.1"
futures = "0.3.31"
rand = "0.8.5"
reqwest-eventsource = "0.6.0"
serde_json = "1.0.135"
thiserror = "2.0.11"
tokio-stream = "0.1.17"
tracing = "0.1.41"
derive_builder = "0.20.2"
bytes = "1.9.0"
eventsource-stream = "0.2.3"
schemars = "0.8.21"

[dependencies.backoff]
version = "0.4.0"
features = ["tokio"]

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.12.12"
features = ["json", "stream", "multipart"]
default-features = false

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.217"
features = ["derive", "rc"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.43.0"
features = ["fs", "macros"]

[dependencies.tokio-util]
version = "0.7.13"
features = ["codec", "io-util"]

[dependencies.secrecy]
version = "0.10.3"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.tokio-tungstenite]
version = "0.26.1"
optional = true
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies]
tokio-test = "0.4.4"

[package]
name = "hf-hub"
version = "0.4.3"
edition = "2021"
homepage = "https://github.com/huggingface/hf-hub"
license = "Apache-2.0"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/hf-hub"
repository = "https://github.com/huggingface/hf-hub"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["huggingface", "hf", "hub", "machine-learning"]
description = "This crates aims ease the interaction with huggingface\nIt aims to be compatible with the huggingface_hub python package, but only implements a smaller subset of functions.\n"

[dependencies]
dirs = "6"
log = "0.4.19"

[dependencies.futures]
version = "0.3.28"
optional = true

[dependencies.http]
version = "1.0.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.indicatif]
version = "0.18"
optional = true

[dependencies.num_cpus]
version = "1.15.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.rand]
version = "0.9"
optional = true

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.12.2"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["json", "stream"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]
optional = true

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.thiserror]
version = "2"
optional = true

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.29.1"
optional = true
features = ["fs", "macros"]

[dependencies.ureq]
version = "3"
optional = true
features = ["json", "socks-proxy"]

[dependencies.native-tls]
version = "0.2.12"
optional = true

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows-sys]
version = "0.61"
features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_Storage_FileSystem", "Win32_System_IO"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(unix)".dependencies.libc]
version = "0.2"
optional = true

[features]
default = ["default-tls", "tokio", "ureq"]
default-tls = ["native-tls"]
native-tls = ["dep:reqwest", "reqwest?/default", "dep:native-tls", "dep:ureq", "ureq?/native-tls"]
rustls-tls = ["reqwest?/rustls-tls"]
tokio = ["dep:futures", "dep:indicatif", "dep:num_cpus", "dep:rand", "dep:reqwest", "reqwest/charset", "reqwest/http2", "reqwest/macos-system-configuration", "dep:serde", "dep:serde_json", "dep:thiserror", "dep:tokio", "tokio/rt-multi-thread", "dep:libc", "dep:windows-sys"]
ureq = ["dep:http", "dep:indicatif", "dep:rand", "dep:serde", "dep:serde_json", "dep:thiserror", "dep:ureq", "dep:libc", "dep:windows-sys"]

[dev-dependencies]
hex-literal = "1.0"
sha2 = "0.10"
tokio-test = "0.4.2"

[package]
name = "knf-rs"
version = "0.3.2"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
description = "fbank features extractor without external dependencies"
repository = "https://github.com/thewh1teagle/pyannote-rs"

[dependencies]
eyre = "0.6.12"
ndarray = "0.16"

[dependencies.knf-rs-sys]
path = "sys"
version = "0.3.2"
features = []

[features]
default = []

[package]
name = "knf-rs-sys"
version = "0.3.2"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
description = "fbank features extractor without external dependencies"
repository = "https://github.com/thewh1teagle/pyannote-rs"
include = ["knfc", "knf/kaldi-native-fbank/csrc", "knf/kaldi-native-fbank/CMakeLists.txt", "knf/cmake", "knf/CMakeLists.txt", "knf/LICENSE", "src/*.rs", "build.rs", "wrapper.hpp"]

[build-dependencies]
bindgen = "0.69.4"
cmake = "0.1.50"

[features]
default = []

[package]
name = "swift-rs"
version = "1.0.7"
description = "Call Swift from Rust with ease!"
authors = ["The swift-rs contributors"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/Brendonovich/swift-rs"
edition = "2021"
exclude = ["/src-swift", "*.swift"]
build = "src-rs/test-build.rs"

[package.metadata."docs.rs"]
all-features = true
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[lib]
path = "src-rs/lib.rs"

[dependencies]
base64 = "0.21.0"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]
optional = true

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0"
optional = true

[build-dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]

[build-dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0"

[dev-dependencies]
serial_test = "0.10"

[features]
default = []
build = ["serde", "serde_json"]

[workspace]
members = [".", "examples/basic/src-tauri", "examples/panel_builder/src-tauri", "examples/fullscreen/src-tauri", "examples/mouse_tracking/src-tauri", "examples/hover_activate/src-tauri"]

[workspace.dependencies]
tauri = "2.8.5"
tauri-build = "2.4.1"

[package]
name = "tauri-nspanel"
version = "2.1.0"
authors = ["Victor Aremu <me@victorare.mu>"]
description = "A plugin for subclassing Tauri's NSWindow to NSPanel"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.75"
exclude = ["/examples"]

[dependencies]
pastey = "0.2"

[dependencies.tauri]
version = "2.8.5"
features = ["macos-private-api"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
objc2 = "0.6.1"
objc2-app-kit = "0.3.1"
objc2-foundation = "0.3.1"

[features]
cargo-clippy = []

[workspace]
members = ["sys"]
exclude = ["examples/full_usage"]

[workspace.package]
rust-version = "1.88.0"

[package]
name = "whisper-rs"
version = "0.16.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Rust bindings for whisper.cpp"
license = "Unlicense"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/whisper-rs"
repository = "https://codeberg.org/tazz4843/whisper-rs"

[dependencies.whisper-rs-sys]
path = "sys"
version = "0.15"

[dependencies.log]
version = "0.4"
optional = true

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.libc]
version = "0.2"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
hound = "3.5.0"
rand = "0.8.4"

[features]
default = []
raw-api = []
coreml = ["whisper-rs-sys/coreml"]
cuda = ["whisper-rs-sys/cuda", "_gpu"]
hipblas = ["whisper-rs-sys/hipblas", "_gpu"]
openblas = ["whisper-rs-sys/openblas"]
metal = ["whisper-rs-sys/metal", "_gpu"]
vulkan = ["whisper-rs-sys/vulkan", "_gpu", "dep:libc"]
openmp = ["whisper-rs-sys/openmp"]
intel-sycl = ["whisper-rs-sys/intel-sycl", "_gpu"]
_gpu = []
test-with-tiny-model = []
log_backend = ["dep:log"]
tracing_backend = ["dep:tracing"]

[package]
name = "whisper-rs-sys"
version = "0.15.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.88.0"
description = "Rust bindings for whisper.cpp (FFI bindings)"
license = "Unlicense"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/whisper-rs-sys"
repository = "https://codeberg.org/tazz4843/whisper-rs"
links = "whisper"
include = ["whisper.cpp/bindings/javascript/package-tmpl.json", "whisper.cpp/bindings/CMakeLists.txt", "whisper.cpp/CMakeLists.txt", "whisper.cpp/cmake", "whisper.cpp/src/**", "whisper.cpp/include/whisper.h", "whisper.cpp/ggml/cmake", "whisper.cpp/ggml/CMakeLists.txt", "whisper.cpp/ggml/src/**", "whisper.cpp/ggml/include/*.h", "whisper.cpp/LICENSE", "src/*.rs", "build.rs", "wrapper.h"]

[features]
coreml = []
cuda = []
hipblas = []
openblas = []
metal = []
vulkan = []
force-debug = []
openmp = []
intel-sycl = []

[build-dependencies]
cmake = "0.1"
bindgen = "0.72"
cfg-if = "1"
fs_extra = "1.3"
semver = "1.0"

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/fastrepl/async-openai"]
git = "https://github.com/fastrepl/async-openai"
replace-with = "vendored-async-openai-6404d30"
rev = "6404d307f3f706e818ad91544dc82fac5c545aee"

[source.vendored-async-openai-6404d30]
directory = "cargo/vendored-async-openai-6404d30"

[source."https://github.com/fastrepl/gbnf-validator"]
git = "https://github.com/fastrepl/gbnf-validator"
replace-with = "vendored-gbnf-validator-3dec055"
rev = "3dec055"

[source.vendored-gbnf-validator-3dec055]
directory = "cargo/vendored-gbnf-validator-3dec055"

[source."https://github.com/huggingface/hf-hub"]
git = "https://github.com/huggingface/hf-hub"
replace-with = "vendored-hf-hub-5510260"
rev = "5510260"

[source.vendored-hf-hub-5510260]
directory = "cargo/vendored-hf-hub-5510260"

[source."https://github.com/thewh1teagle/pyannote-rs"]
git = "https://github.com/thewh1teagle/pyannote-rs"
replace-with = "vendored-pyannote-rs-e23bd29"
rev = "e23bd29"

[source.vendored-pyannote-rs-e23bd29]
directory = "cargo/vendored-pyannote-rs-e23bd29"

[source."https://github.com/Brendonovich/swift-rs"]
git = "https://github.com/Brendonovich/swift-rs"
replace-with = "vendored-swift-rs-41a1605"
rev = "41a1605"

[source.vendored-swift-rs-41a1605]
directory = "cargo/vendored-swift-rs-41a1605"

[source."https://github.com/ahkohd/tauri-nspanel"]
git = "https://github.com/ahkohd/tauri-nspanel"
replace-with = "vendored-tauri-nspanel-a3122e8"
branch = "v2.1"

[source.vendored-tauri-nspanel-a3122e8]
directory = "cargo/vendored-tauri-nspanel-a3122e8"

[source."https://codeberg.org/tazz4843/whisper-rs"]
git = "https://codeberg.org/tazz4843/whisper-rs"
replace-with = "vendored-whisper-rs-129b982"
rev = "129b982"

[source.vendored-whisper-rs-129b982]
directory = "cargo/vendored-whisper-rs-129b982"
